plain_english_summary: Deterministic motion-capture compression and retrieval system, currently bounded to synthetic evidence.
commercial_wedge: Motion fingerprinting and similarity retrieval for mocap archives.
technical_wedge: Deterministic 8-primitive encoding applied to motion-capture data. CMU fixture corpus (10 real BVH clips): 18.77x compression, 32.45 mm MPJPE, 82.51 deg angle RMSE. Synthetic corpus (identity encoding): 85.19x compression, 1.19 mm MPJPE. Synthetic numbers are a theoretical ceiling — real data must be quantized from continuous joint positions.
ideal_first_buyer: Animation pipeline or mocap-data infrastructure team evaluating deterministic compression with search for motion archives.
deployment_model: Python reference implementation (pip install -e ./code). Public repo, not a packaged release.
proof_anchors: 2026-04-14 CMU fixture corpus benchmark (10 real BVH clips): 18.77x compression, 32.45 mm MPJPE, 82.51 deg RMSE
2026-02-20 synthetic-corpus wave1 bundle (identity encoding): 85.19x compression, 1.19 mm MPJPE
ACL direct comparator table (circular methodology — synthetic data generated from ZPE tokens)
not_claimed: No real-data parity with synthetic benchmarks (identity encoding inflates synthetic numbers)
No fair competitive benchmarks (ACL comparison is circular — fed synthetic data from ZPE tokens)
No production-grade fidelity on real data (32.45 mm MPJPE, 82.51 deg angle RMSE on CMU fixture)
No clean-clone verification from this repo boundary
family_position: Proves ZPE encoding applicability to motion-capture and spatial-temporal signal domains. Staged/validation tier alongside Neuro, Prosody, and Bio.
